quality.hardDesign: 주어(복수 readings)와 동사 사이에 대조 표현(unlike the smoothed averages)과 조건 단서(only when cross-checked against...)를 이중으로 삽입해 진짜 주어를 찾기 어렵게 하고, 오답에 단수 동사형 'turns out to reveal'을 배치해 삽입구 속 단수 명사(coral-growth bands 앞 수식어나 averages)로 수 일치를 착각하게 설계했다. 나머지 두 오답은 원본과 동일하게 비정형 분사 함정을 유지해 정동사 여부까지 함께 판단해야 한다.

problem.passage:
The Sundarbans mangrove archive, compiled by marine botanists Priya Nair and Tomas Alderete over eleven field seasons, contains sediment cores that can be dated and cross-referenced to reveal shifting salinity patterns across three centuries of monsoon cycles. Analysts who reprocessed the cores using isotope spectrometry uncovered layers of misclassified pollen that had obscured the region's original, more erratic rainfall record. Paleoclimatologists reviewing the reprocessed data report that the archive's earliest salinity readings, unlike the smoothed averages that had long been assumed to reflect a stable pre-industrial baseline, only when cross-checked against newly recovered coral-growth bands ______ evidence of monsoon volatility considerably more extreme than researchers had previously attributed to the pre-1850 delta.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: The Sundarbans mangrove archive, compiled by marine botanists Priya Nair and Tomas Alderete over eleven field seasons, contains sediment cores that can be dated and cross-referenced to reveal shifting salinity patterns across three centuries of monsoon cycles. Analysts who reprocessed the cores using isotope spectrometry uncovered layers of misclassified pollen that had obscured the region's original, more erratic rainfall record. Paleoclimatologists reviewing the reprocessed data report that the archive's earliest salinity readings, unlike the smoothed averages that had long been assumed to reflect a stable pre-industrial baseline, only when cross-checked against newly recovered coral-growth bands ______ evidence of monsoon volatility considerably more extreme than researchers had previously attributed to the pre-1850 delta.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: 문장의 골격은 'Paleoclimatologists... report that the archive's earliest salinity readings... ______ evidence...'이다. that절의 진짜 주어는 'the archive's earliest salinity readings'(복수)이며, 'unlike the smoothed averages...'와 'only when cross-checked against newly recovered coral-growth bands'는 모두 주어와 동사 사이에 끼어든 삽입 수식어구(대조·조건 단서)일 뿐 주어를 바꾸지 않는다. 보고동사 'report'가 현재시제이므로 that절에도 정동사가 필요하고, 복수 주어 'readings'와 수를 맞추면서 완전한 동사구를 이루는 것은 'turn out to reveal'이다. D) 'turns out to reveal'은 단수 동사형이라 복수 주어 'readings'와 수가 어긋난다(주어를 'unlike the smoothed averages' 구의 단수 명사로 착각하게 만드는 함정). B) 'turning out to reveal'과 C) 'having turned out to reveal'은 비정형 분사구로 that절의 정동사 자리를 채울 수 없어 문장이 완결되지 않는다.
